Indikator 8 tracks the epidural insertion rate (epidural-anlæggelsesraten) across Danish regions and hospital units. The established standard for this indicator is a rate greater than 60% [^src2]. 

In the most recent reporting period (2024), the national average was 52.2%, meaning [[danmark|Danmark]] as a whole missed the > 60% target [^src2]. Performance varied widely among hospitals. [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] led the country with a 72.9% rate, followed by [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]] at 68.0% and [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] at 64.7% [^src2]. Only five units successfully met the > 60% standard: the three aforementioned hospitals, along with [[ouh-odense-universitetshospital-odense|OUH Odense Universitetshospital (Odense)]] (61.5%) and [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]] (61.4%) [^src2]. Conversely, the lowest rates were recorded at [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted]] (0.0%, with zero cases) and [[naestved-slagese-og-ringsted-sygehuse|Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse]] (24.6%) [^src2]. At the regional level, all regions missed the target, with [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] trailing at 41.9% and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] at 44.1% [^src2].

Looking at the previous year's data from the 2023 report, the national fulfillment rate (opfyldelse) was significantly lower at 19.6% [^src1]. In that period, [[bispebjerg-og-frederiksberg-hospitaler|Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler]] led with 53.9%, while [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]] followed at 49.0% [^src1]. The lowest performers included [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] at 0.2% and [[naestved-slagese-og-ringsted-sygehuse|Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse]] at 9.3% [^src1]. While the national average saw a massive increase from 19.6% in 2023 to 52.2% in 2024, this jump likely reflects a change in how the indicator is calculated or reported (e.g., measuring overall fulfillment versus the raw epidural rate), rather than a pure clinical surge [^src1][^src2].

Across both reporting periods, [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]] stands out as a consistent high performer, ranking near the top in both 2023 and 2024 [^src1][^src2]. A notable outlier in the 2024 data is [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted]], which reported zero cases and a 0.0% rate, breaking the pattern of active reporting seen in other units [^src2].
